newsitem.title: USA: Nexus and Global Wireless to form alliance.
newsitem.headline: Nexus and Global Wireless to form alliance.

text.p: Nexus Telecomm Systems Inc said Wednesday it has signed a letter to form a strategic alliance with Global Wireless Communications LP.

Under the proposal, said the company, Global will purchase, for a total price of $4.5 million, warrants exercisable into three million common shares of Nexus at a price of $5.35 per share. The exercise period is five years.

Global said that through its affiliates, it will begin commercial ventures for the distribution of Nexus products and services in some emerging country markets. To facilitate this, Global will additionally invest up to $5.0 million.
The agreement is subject to completion of customary due diligence and is scheduled to close by May 15, 1997.
Nexus is engaged in the development, manufacture and marketing of low energy wireless communications and location systems.
